personality_one_liner: A highly legible, content-first marketplace where product photos take center stage, supported by trustworthy moss green accents and crisp typography.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards never flush to screen edge; always use at least md padding. Forms use ample spacing between fields.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use on the bottom tab bar
Apply subtle frosted glass on hero image overlays
dont's: Never apply to form inputs, regular buttons, or body content
Do not overdo on lists or dense data screens

screens.name: Auth (Login & Register)
screens.purpose: Clean, trustworthy entry point to authenticate users.

states.error: Inline text below inputs or standard alert for invalid credentials.

screens.layout: Simple column layout centered vertically. Logo at top, followed by form inputs (Email, Password) with labels above inputs. Primary sticky CTA at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView. Link to toggle Login/Register.

screens.name: Home (Listings Feed)
screens.purpose: Discover what's being sold nearby, with a clear view of item, price, and seller.

states.empty: Illustration of an open box with text 'Nenhum anúncio encontrado' and a refresh CTA.
states.error: Message 'Não foi possível carregar' with retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with Search bar and horizontal scrollable Category chips (Carros, Telefones, Móveis, Acessórios). Below, a 2-column masonry or grid layout for listings. Each card shows: product photo, title, price (bold), and tiny seller name/avatar. Safe area padding applied.

screens.name: Listing Detail
screens.purpose: Immersive view of the product, showing all seller details and a prominent WhatsApp contact button.

states.loading: Skeleton for image hero and text blocks.
states.error: Message if listing was removed/not found.

screens.layout: Full-width photo carousel at the top (with pagination dots). Below: Title, Condition (Novo/Usado), and Price. Then a section for Seller info (Avatar, Name, City/State). Then Description and Delivery status (Entrega: Sim/Não). Sticky primary CTA 'Chamar no WhatsApp' at the very bottom.

screens.name: Create Listing
screens.purpose: Step-by-step or single long-form page to allow users to post an ad effortlessly.
screens.layout: Horizontal scroll row at the top for up to 5 photos (first slot is 'Add photo' button). Followed by single-column form with clear labels above inputs: Title, Description, Price, Condition (segmented control), Category (dropdown/sheet), City/State, Delivery (switch), WhatsApp number. Sticky CTA 'Publicar Anúncio' at bottom.

screens.name: My Listings
screens.purpose: Manage personal active and sold listings.

states.empty: Illustration of a storefront with text 'Você ainda não tem anúncios' and a 'Criar Anúncio' primary CTA.

screens.layout: Single column list view (not grid). Each row shows a small thumbnail, title, price, and stats (views). Includes 'Remover' or 'Editar' options.

screens.name: Admin Panel
screens.purpose: Dedicated area for administrators to view app stats, manage users, and remove listings.

states.empty: Empty state if no users/listings to review.

screens.layout: Dashboard feel but keeping mobile constraints. Top summary cards (Total Users, Active Listings). Below, two distinct sections or tabs: 'Usuários' and 'Anúncios'. Admin can tap a listing to view it and press a destructive 'Remover Anúncio' CTA. Admin requires a separate login flag.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design standard: Follow iOS-Native Clean (Personality 1). Use generous spacing, rounded corners (md:12, lg:20), and subtle shadow (tier 1).
Navigation: Implement a Bottom Tab bar with Home, Post, My Listings, and Admin (if user is admin). Ensure the tab bar uses glassmorphism if content scrolls behind it.

Data Structure: Since backend is not explicitly provided, mock the data structures (listings, users) using realistic local state/context so the flows (login, register, add listing, admin remove listing) can be demonstrated.
Form UX: For the 'Create Listing' screen, use KeyboardAvoidingView and keep the primary 'Publicar Anúncio' CTA sticky at the bottom. Use a horizontal ScrollView for the 5 photo slots.
Typography: Use Plus Jakarta Sans with strict weight constraints (max 500 font weight everywhere). Create hierarchy through size, not extreme weights.
No Banned Colors: Strictly avoid all shades of blue, purple, indigo. Rely on the provided Moss Green (#2A4B3C) for trust and primary branding.
Admin Panel: Build a basic Admin Dashboard that lists all users and active listings. Provide a 'Remove' button for the admin to moderate content. Add a mock login switch to enter as admin.
Portuguese (Brazil): All UI text, form labels, and placeholders must be in Portuguese.

Image Scrims: Any text overlaid on images (like photo pagination dots or badges over the listing photo) MUST use a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to ensure text readability.
